children: New Delhi, Oct. 31 -- State-owned NTPC Limited reported a 38.7% year-on-year jump in its consolidated net profit (attributable to owners of the company) to Rs.7,029.56 crore for the second quarter of financial year 2026-27. Besides Q2 results, the Maharatna PSU announced its first interim dividend for FY27.
NTPC share price closed 2.23% higher at Rs.316 per share on BSE with a market capitalisation of Rs.3,06,414.65 crore on Friday, October 30. Here are all the details to know about NTPC Q2 result

The company's board of directors, on Saturday, declared an interim dividend at the rate of 30% on the face value of Rs.10 each for FY27. This is the first interim dividend announced by the PSU for the current financial year. The board has also fixed a record date for the payout to fix eligibility of shareholders for the corporate action.

NTPC's board fixed November 6 as the record date to determine the eligibility of shareholders for the payout. The dividend is expected to be paid within the statutory period starting from November 25, 2026 onwards, as per the BSE filing.
NTPC Limited reported a 38.7% annual jump in its net profit to Rs.7,029.56 crore for the September quarter of FY27, its net profit stood at Rs.5,066.78 crore reported in the year ago period.
Its net consolidated revenue from operations surged by 21.2% to Rs.54,269.95 crore from Rs.44,784.05 crore a year earlier. Its total income increased to Rs.54,715.69 crore from Rs.45,262.10 crore.

Whereas, its total expenses increased to Rs.48,059.30 crore during the quarter under review from Rs.40,218.03 crore. Its fuel cost surged to Rs.28,628.19 crore from Rs.23,062.34 crore during the same period.

The stock closed 2.23% higher at Rs.316 per share on BSE with a market capitalisation of Rs.3,06,414.65 crore on Friday. THe PSU stock has delivered 6% return in one week, but has declined 1.86% in one month, 8.27% in three months and around 20.82% in six months.
